items.headline: 把传感器直接打印进物件
items.headline_en: Printing sensors directly into everyday objects
items.summary: MIT 10月22日介绍X-Hinges设计工具：传感器与导电连线用不同材料打印，减少信号互扰，让手套、灯等物件感知弯曲并响应动作。它把结构设计与测量连起来，支持多方向运动；目前仍是原型研究，不同打印件的读数仍需校准，通用性还待改进。
items.summary_en: On October 22, MIT described X-Hinges, which prints sensors and conducting traces from different materials to reduce signal interference. Gloves and lamps can then measure bending and respond to movement. The tool connects mechanical design with measurement across multiple directions. This remains prototype research: readings from separately printed devices still need calibration, and broader usability requires further development.

source.name: 麻省理工学院 / MIT News

items.headline: 用两次激光扫描，看海崖怎样后退
items.headline_en: Two laser surveys reveal how coastal cliffs retreat
items.summary: UCSD 10月23日报道，研究者比较2016与2023年的机载激光雷达资料，重建加州海崖三维变化，发现退缩高度不均匀，集中于局部热点。激光测距把地形变化变成可比较的数据，可服务海岸规划；七年平均退缩率不是逐年匀速，更不能预测某次崩塌的确切时间。
items.summary_en: UC San Diego reported on October 23 that researchers compared airborne lidar surveys from 2016 and 2023 to reconstruct changes in California's coastal cliffs. Retreat was highly uneven and concentrated in hotspots. Laser ranging turns changing terrain into comparable three-dimensional data for coastal planning. A seven-year average does not imply steady annual retreat or predict the exact timing of an individual collapse.

source.name: 加州大学圣迭戈分校 / UC San Diego

items.headline: 气候冲击，怎样沿经济链传递？
items.headline_en: How climate shocks travel through an economy
items.summary: UCSD 10月20日介绍加州气候经济影响报告：高温、烟尘和缺水会影响健康、工时与农业，冲击还能传到食品价格和家庭开支。损失因地区与人群而异，户外劳动者等更易暴露。报告综合已有研究和情景推算，帮助理解风险如何传导；未来估算依赖升温等假设，并非确定账单。
items.summary_en: UC San Diego described a climate-economy report on October 20. Heat, smoke and water shortages affect health, working hours and agriculture, with consequences spreading to food prices and household costs. Exposure differs across regions and groups, including outdoor workers. The report combines existing research and scenario projections to explain how risks spread; future estimates depend on warming assumptions rather than being certain bills.

source.name: 加州大学圣迭戈分校 / UC San Diego

items.headline: 电子烟研究：看清比例，也看清因果
items.headline_en: Vaping research: distinguish percentages from causes
items.summary: UCSD 10月20日报道，美国18—24岁每日电子烟使用者中，高尼古丁产品使用率从2017年的3.1%升至2022年的49.2%，并与更强依赖相关。尼古丁作用于脑的奖励回路，产品浓度与使用方式都值得研究。观察数据不能单独证明因果，这些比例也不代表全体青年。
items.summary_en: UC San Diego reported on October 20 that high-nicotine product use among US daily vapers aged 18–24 rose from 3.1% in 2017 to 49.2% in 2022 and was associated with greater dependence. Nicotine acts on brain reward circuits, making product strength and use patterns relevant. Observational data do not establish causation, and these percentages do not describe all young adults.

source.name: 加州大学圣迭戈分校 / UC San Diego

items.headline: Swift停止观测，档案仍可用于研究
items.headline_en: Swift stops observing; its archive remains open for research
items.summary: NASA 10月23日宣布，Swift于20日完成最后观测。轨道降低后，大气阻力妨碍望远镜稳定指向，科学任务因此结束。它曾迅速定位伽马射线暴，再转向捕捉易消逝的余辉，说明观测速度也是科学能力。近22年的公开档案仍可研究；替代快速响应能力仍在探索。
items.summary_en: NASA announced on October 23 that Swift made its final observation on October 20. As its orbit lowered, atmospheric drag prevented steady telescope pointing, ending science operations. Swift rapidly located gamma-ray bursts and turned to catch fading afterglows, showing why response speed matters in astronomy. Nearly 22 years of public archival data remain available; replacement rapid-response capabilities are still being explored.

items.headline: 先在地面模拟，练习土卫六自主着陆
items.headline_en: Rehearsing an autonomous Titan landing on Earth
items.summary: NASA 10月23日报道，Dragonfly在类飞行航电测试台上实时模拟首次飞行与着陆。模拟的相机、惯性测量和激光雷达输入，帮助软件选择安全地点，并让工程师核对系统协同。土卫六遥远，需自主决策；这仍是地面测试，实际飞行系统及故障应对还需验证。
items.summary_en: NASA reported on October 23 that Dragonfly rehearsed its first flight and landing in real time on a flight-like avionics testbed. Simulated camera, inertial and lidar inputs helped software select safe terrain while engineers checked system interactions. Titan's distance makes autonomous decisions essential. This was a ground test; validation on the actual flight system and fault-response testing are still ahead.

previous_answers.headline: 5×5方格起初全白。每步可选一整行或一整列，把其中所有格子黑白互换。若最终至少有一个黑格，黑格最少能有几个？给出做法，并证明不能更少。
previous_answers.headline_en: A 5×5 grid starts entirely white. Each move flips every cell in one whole row or column between black and white. If at least one cell ends black, what is the smallest possible number of black cells? Give a construction and prove it is minimal.
previous_answers.explanation: 任取两行两列的四角，每次翻0或2角，黑角数恒为偶数。若仅1—4个黑格，必有全白行和列；用任一黑格及它们围成四角，就只有1黑角，矛盾。故至少5；翻一整行恰得5。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Every rectangle formed by two rows and columns keeps an even number of black corners: a move flips zero or two. With 1–4 black cells, an all-white row and column would exist; any black cell would then define a rectangle with one black corner, impossible. Flipping one whole row attains five.

previous_answers.eyebrow: 上期思考题参考解答 / PREVIOUS ANSWER
previous_answers.headline: 不断独立投掷一枚公平硬币，直到连续三次的结果首次出现HHT或HTH便停止（H为正面，T为反面）。哪一种更可能先出现？求它的概率，并说明理由。
previous_answers.headline_en: Keep tossing a fair coin independently until HHT or HTH first appears as three consecutive results (H=heads, T=tails). Which pattern is more likely to appear first? Find its probability and justify your answer.
previous_answers.result_en: HHT wins with probability 2/3; HTH with 1/3
previous_answers.explanation: 设刚出现H后HHT先出的概率为p。下一次H，则等到T必由HHT胜；下一次T，再出H则HTH胜，再出T则重回起点。因此p=1/2+p/4，得2/3。开头的T只延迟首个H，不改变胜率。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Let p be the chance that HHT wins just after H. A following H leads to an HHT win at the first T. A following T then H lets HTH win; a following T then T resets the process. Thus p=1/2+p/4, so p=2/3. Initial tails merely delay the first H.
previous_answers.subject: W43 · 硬币图案解答

previous_answers.eyebrow: 上期思考题参考解答 / PREVIOUS ANSWER
previous_answers.headline: 从1至60中选出一些不同的整数，要求选出的数中不存在a<b<c，使b是a的整数倍且c是b的整数倍。最多能选几个？给出一组选法，并证明无法选得更多。
previous_answers.headline_en: Choose distinct integers from 1 to 60. Your set must not contain a<b<c with b a multiple of a and c a multiple of b. What is the largest possible number of selected integers? Give an example and prove optimality.
previous_answers.explanation: 按奇数部分分链u、2u、4u……，链中任取三数都违例。15条长链各至多取2数，15条单元素链各至多取1数，故至多45。取16至60共45数；若a|b|c，则c≥4a≥64，矛盾。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Group numbers into chains u,2u,4u,… for odd u. Any three from one chain are forbidden. Fifteen longer chains allow at most two selections each; fifteen singleton chains allow one, giving 45. Select 16–60. A divisibility triple would give c≥4a≥64, impossible.
previous_answers.subject: W43 · 倍数链极值解答

Can the remaining 34 squares always be tiled by seventeen 1×2 dominoes without overlap? Rotation is allowed; dominoes must stay inside the board.
